south-africa-1999.notes: Source 1 copy is the 2000 contest's page (belongs_to south-africa-2000): hosted by the University of Pretoria with Rhodes University and the University of Cape Town, 16 September 2000; it links 'Final Standings' (report_2000.html), not in our copy.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw an unrelated MECS Project 2000 page at this address; our copy (Wayback, January 2001) is the announcement page of the 2000 contest, so it is a document of another edition rather than no contest page at all.
sources.evidence: The page is headed 'The 2000 ACM South Africa Programming Contest', 'Date of Contest: Saturday, 16 September 2000', calls it the second South African regional contest, and does not mention 1999.
